spec.title: Add secondary action support to VSCode TreeView
spec.context: The TreeView currently shows only one action per task (the first/primary action), but task-actions.computer.ts already returns multiple actions for statuses like qa (Approve/Rework), pr (Merge/Rework), and in-progress (Continue/Save WIP). Users cannot trigger secondary actions from the TreeView and must open task.xml or use the terminal manually.

in-scope.item: Display all available actions as ActionItems when a task is expanded
Visual distinction between primary (green play) and secondary (orange reply) actions
Clickable secondary actions that execute via terminal

out-of-scope.item: Adding new actions to task-actions.computer.ts (actions already exist)
Modifying CodeLens behavior (already shows all actions)
Changing action ordering or priority logic

requirements.requirement: The system shall display all available actions from getActions() as ActionItems when a task is expanded in the TreeView
The system shall render the first action (primary) with a green play icon using ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green'))
The system shall render subsequent actions (secondary) with an orange reply icon using ThemeIcon('reply', ThemeColor('charts.orange'))
Each ActionItem shall execute its corresponding command via terminal when clicked
Tasks in 'done' status shall continue to show no ActionItems

files.file: Change getNextAction to getAllActions - return full actions array instead of just first element
Update TasksViewCapabilityDeps interface, TaskItem constructor, ActionItem class, and getChildrenForTask to support multiple actions with primary/secondary distinction

patterns.pattern: Used for icon styling with theme compatibility. Reference: tasks-view.capability.ts:185
Dependencies injected via factory function parameters. Reference: extension.ts:155-163
Pure action logic in computer, rendering in capability. Reference: task-actions.computer.ts

product.finding: Documents current limitation: "Does NOT: Show multiple actions (only next action in workflow)"
Already displays ALL actions - pattern to follow for consistency

engineering.finding: Three-layer architecture: Orchestrator decides when, Capabilities handle how, Computers define what

pitfalls.pitfall: Array position determines primary/secondary - no interface change needed

constraints.constraint: Must use VSCode ThemeIcon and ThemeColor for theme compatibility (design directive)
Explicit return types on exported functions (typescript directive)

risk.mitigation: Use array index to determine primary vs secondary

risks.risk: TaskAction interface has no isPrimary flag - relying on position
